paper.alpha_definition: section 3, printed page 4: positive mixture fraction within U
paper.objective: alpha_U * mean positive loss + (1-alpha_U) * mean retained-negative loss
paper.stopping: convergence of training error; no finite-sample integer count rule specified

source_differences.source_value: (mean positive CE + mean retained U CE) / 2
source_differences.toolbox_value: paper Algorithm 2 alpha-weighted BCE; warm-start uses the legacy unscaled sum
source_differences.decision: retain paper objective; source implementation is a different empirical weighting

source_differences.source_value: n_U - int(alpha_U * n_U) retained; np.argsort default tie ordering
source_differences.toolbox_value: max(1, floor((1-alpha_U) * n_U)) retained; stable tie ordering
source_differences.decision: retain documented finite-sample toolbox rule, record one-row discrepancy when noninteger

source_differences.source_value: warm-start block requires warm_start and train_method == TEDn; CVIR skips it
source_differences.toolbox_value: default one PvU warm-start epoch before fixed-alpha CVIR
source_differences.decision: retain compatible toolbox default; warm_start_epochs=0 explicitly omits it

source_differences.source_value: zip P and original U loaders; mask retained U in each batch, skip empty mask, concatenate P and U for forward
source_differences.toolbox_value: shuffle P and retained U separately, max-length modulo-start batches, separate P/N forwards
source_differences.decision: engineering adaptation; especially not equivalent for BatchNorm or stochastic augmentation

source_differences.source_value: CLI defaults SGD lr0.1/momentum0.9/wd0.0005, batch200, epochs5000; actual data loaders can override sizes, CIFAR script uses epochs2000; Adam optional
source_differences.toolbox_value: Adam lr0.001, no weight decay, batch128, warm1 + CVIR20 fixed epochs
source_differences.decision: neither default is the abstract paper convergence rule; not source recipe replay

source_differences.source_value: alpha explicitly controls U mixture; CVIR uses supplied alpha, TEDn uses estimated alpha; ranking returns true-label rejection diagnostic; estimate-alpha defaults to computing extra validation estimators even for CVIR, not feeding them to its training alpha
source_differences.toolbox_value: explicit fixed alpha_U only; no true-label diagnostic, BBE or TEDn alternation
source_differences.decision: do not infer alpha_U from population pi or labeled fraction; no clean-label reads added; additional source diagnostic estimator costs are not included in toolbox CVIR

source_differences.source_value: beta controls n_P/(n_P+n_U); CIFAR U batch=int(P_batch*(1-beta)/beta); both U class counts are rounded separately
source_differences.toolbox_value: alpha_U supplied explicitly, P/U role sizes come from input; no beta constructor or beta-to-c substitution
source_differences.decision: source beta is not protocol c; verify actual finite-sample counts and branch-specific batch sizes before comparing

source_cifar_recipe.ranking_augmentation: U train loader is reused for ranking, so RandomCrop(32,padding=4) and RandomHorizontalFlip also apply during source eval ranking; toolbox uses already supplied arrays without adding these transforms
source_cifar_recipe.validation_origin: helper.py constructs validation P/U from train=False original CIFAR partition; not automatically equivalent to the project's four-role split

engineering_scope.inputs: dense 2-D features or 4-D NCHW with independently cloned trainable encoder
engineering_scope.data_policy: auto preserves legacy resident 2-D; encoder uses CPU-streamed input; explicit cpu_stream available
engineering_scope.device_batch_bound: batch_size for each train, rank and predict forward in cpu_stream; full inputs and rank vector still occupy CPU memory
engineering_scope.cost: optimizer_steps_ covers both stages; epoch_provenance_ and checkpoint training_context record stage, round and cumulative steps
